name: Rocky Creek Farms
tagline: At the Farm — Gallatin Valley Botanical
description: Rocky Creek Farms is a pumpkin patch in Bozeman, MT. Visitors come for Raspberries, Apples, Pumpkins, and Corn, best in autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Sep in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
